WorkflowMigrateHint: KittyClaw analysiert das aktuelle Board und bereitet eine sichere, schrittweise Migration vor. Die Anweisung kann vor dem Senden geprüft und bearbeitet werden.
WorkflowPipelinesHint: Eine Pipeline besitzt eine stabile Identität. Eine Umbenennung ändert weder Verknüpfungen, Spalten, Tickets noch Routingregeln.
WorkflowColumnsHint: Verwalten Sie hier die Pipeline-Struktur. Um einen Spaltenprozessor zu konfigurieren, klicken Sie mit der rechten Maustaste auf den Spaltenkopf im Board und wählen Sie Konfigurieren.
WorkflowProjectSkillsHint: Wiederverwendbare technische und betriebliche Verfahren für Spaltenprozessoren. Ihr stabiler Schlüssel bleibt beim Umbenennen erhalten.
WorkflowSkillUsage: Wann soll der Agent diesen Skill verwenden?
WorkflowPipelineRenamed: Pipeline umbenannt; der stabile Schlüssel blieb erhalten.
WorkflowSkillSaved: Skill gespeichert; der stabile Schlüssel blieb erhalten.
MigrationWizardIntro: This board still relies on legacy automations. KittyClaw can analyse it and prepare a visual, reviewable migration to pipelines and column processors.
MigrationBenefitReliableText: Each column owns one processor and KittyClaw controls retries, concurrency and routing.
MigrationBenefitVisibleText: Pipelines, columns, human decisions and terminal outcomes are visible directly on the board.
MigrationBenefitAdaptedText: Different work can live in separate pipelines with their own rules.
MigrationWizardSafeNote: Nothing is changed during the wizard. Legacy automations are disabled only after their replacement has been verified.
MigrationWizardAnalyzingHint: It is identifying distinct lifecycles from tickets, automations, agents, schedules and routing rules.
MigrationWizardProgressInspecting: Inspecting the project and its workflow…
MigrationWizardProgressAnalyzing: The planning agent is designing the pipelines…
MigrationWizardAgentThinking: The agent is working on the proposal
MigrationWizardLongRunningHint: Large boards can take a few minutes. This window will update automatically.
MigrationWizardReviewHint: You can still go back to adjust any pipeline or column.
MigrationWizardStartFailed: The analysis could not be started.
MigrationWizardErrorTitle: The proposal could not be prepared
MigrationWizardErrorTooLarge: This board contains too much raw information to analyse at once. KittyClaw will retry from a compact workflow summary.
MigrationWizardErrorInterrupted: The analysis was interrupted. You can safely retry it.
MigrationWizardErrorInvalidPlan: The analysis did not return a usable workflow proposal. Retry to generate a new proposal.
MigrationWizardErrorAgentFailed: The planning agent stopped before producing a proposal. Retry the analysis; your board has not been changed.
ProjectOnboardingIntro: KittyClaw will inspect the target folder and propose adapted pipelines.
ProjectOnboardingQuestionsTitle: Tell us how this project will work
ProjectOnboardingQuestionsIntro: The folder is empty, so a few short answers are needed before KittyClaw can propose a useful workflow.
ProjectOnboardingPurpose: What is this project intended to achieve?
ProjectOnboardingDeliverables: What distinct types of work or deliverables will it contain?
ProjectOnboardingDeliverablesHint: Mention work streams that may need different lifecycles.
ProjectOnboardingHumanSteps: Which decisions or validations require a person?
ProjectOnboardingSchedules: Is any work recurring or scheduled?
MigrationWizardNewPipelineDescription: Describe the purpose and routing of this pipeline.
MigrationWizardApplyingHint: KittyClaw is creating pipelines, configuring columns and processors, moving tickets, then verifying the resulting workflow.
MigrationWizardCompletedHint: The approved workflow has been applied and verified. Review the summary below before closing this wizard.
MigrationWizardApplyErrorTitle: The migration could not be completed
MigrationWizardErrorRateLimited: The selected AI provider has reached its usage limit. No automatic retry was started; retry after the limit resets.
MigrationWizardErrorApplyFailed: The migration agent stopped before completing and verifying the workflow. Review the error, then retry safely.
